rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

bark.howTo: Rotate #jaw (inside #head) to +28 to open the mouth, back to 0 to close. A small head lift (-8) on the open frame sells the bark.

parts.description: Far hind leg (darker); pivot at the hip, top hidden under the body (+ back, - forward).
Far front leg (darker); pivot at the shoulder (+ back, - forward).
Curly tail with a light tip; pivot at the root (+ swings up/forward, - swings down/back; wag between -30 and +30).
Near hind leg; pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward).
Near front leg; pivot at the shoulder (+ back, - forward).
Torso with light chest; covers the leg tops. Pivot near the centre for a gentle bob.
Head with floppy ears, muzzle, nose and eye; contains 'jaw'. Pivot at the neck (+ nods down, - lifts).
Lower jaw with tongue and mouth inside; nested in 'head', pivot at the jaw hinge (+ opens the mouth, 0 = closed).
